pages.text: High in the rainforest, the day is done. Sunny the tree frog sits on his leaf.
The toucan clacks her big bright beak one last time. Then, quiet.
The monkeys chatter and swing and chatter. Then, quiet.
The sloth moves slow, slower, slowest. Then, stop.
The parrots squawk goodnight to each other, all at once.
The jaguar cub curls up on a wide branch and licks her paw.
The butterflies fold their wings under the leaves.
The rain starts, soft as a whisper, drip, drip, drip.
The fireflies blink on, blink off, blink on, blink off.
The moon peeks through the tallest trees.
Sunny closes one eye. Then the other.
The whole rainforest sleeps under the soft, soft rain. Goodnight, Sunny.
